title: Caption Themes Demo
description: Demonstrates all 7 caption themes. Each scene uses a different caption style: minimal, bold, highContrast, softCard, centerPop, topTag, and neon.
script:
Minimal captions - clean and simple. [Visual: text typography minimal] [Transition: fade] [CaptionTheme: minimal]
Bold captions - thicker font for impact. [Visual: bold typography statement] [Transition: slide] [CaptionTheme: bold]
High contrast - yellow on dark. [Visual: contrast lighting dark] [Transition: fade] [CaptionTheme: highContrast]
Soft card - white on subtle background. [Visual: soft gradient background] [Transition: slide] [CaptionTheme: softCard]
Center pop - captions in the middle. [Visual: centered composition design] [Transition: fade] [CaptionTheme: centerPop]
Top tag - captions at the top edge. [Visual: top down perspective] [Transition: slide] [CaptionTheme: topTag]
Neon - glowing cyan on dark box. [Visual: neon lights city night] [Transition: fade] [CaptionTheme: neon]
